commits_this_run: 87936d4 - feat(agents): bound and page the owner agent listing, with an exact total (product)
decisions_this_run: Paging and an exact total had to land together. Adding limit/offset alone would have turned an honest unpaginated len(items) total into a lying paginated one, which is the exact defect NEX-088 fixed in four sibling routes.

The count is a separate scoped SQL COUNT, not len(page) and not an unscoped count_for_owner: the page length answers a different question, and an unscoped aggregate would disclose another user's agent volume.

Order is (created_at, id) because the window is an OFFSET: agents registered in one request burst share created_at to the microsecond, and a non-total order lets a row repeat while another is skipped as the window shifts.
limit is capped at 200 and a larger value is rejected 422 rather than clamped, so a client asking for an impossible page learns it instead of silently receiving a smaller one.
